lines: Kabhi to khul ke baras abr-e-mehrbaan ki tarah
couplets.en: For once, rain freely, like a merciful cloud.

lines: Main ek khwaab sahi, aap ki amaanat hoon
couplets.en: I may be a dream, but I am yours to keep.

lines: Mujhe sambhaal ke rakhiyega jism-o-jaan ki tarah
couplets.en: Keep me safe as you would your own flesh and soul.

lines: Kabhi to soch ke woh shakhs kis qadar tha buland
couplets.en: Think, for once, how tall he once stood.

lines: Jo bichh gaya tere qadmon mein aasmaan ki tarah
couplets.en: He spread himself at your feet like the sky.

lines: Kabhi to khul ke baras abr-e-mehrbaan ki tarah
couplets.en: For once, rain freely, like a merciful cloud.

lines: Bula raha hai mujhe phir kisi badan ka basant
couplets.en: Once more, the spring of someone's body calls to me.

lines: Guzar na jaaye yeh rut bhi kabhi khizaan ki tarah
couplets.en: May this season be spared autumn's passing.

lines: Mera wajood hai jalte hue makaan ki tarah
couplets.en: My whole being is like a house on fire.

lines: Kabhi to khul ke baras abr-e-mehrbaan ki tarah
couplets.en: For once, rain freely, like a merciful cloud.
